polls.description: Escalating tensions as the US accuses China of industrial-scale AI theft while China blocks US tech investments and develops competing models.
polls.question: Are China's AI practices theft or smart competitive strategy?

cluster_stories.title: US Seeks to Halt US AI Model ‘Exploitation’ by Chinese Rivals
cluster_stories.summary: The Trump administration unveiled measures aimed at preventing Chinese developers from improperly using leading American AI models to build a rival generation of chatbots, marking the first major US response to Silicon Valley companies’ complaints that China is piggybacking on their success.
cluster_stories.headline: US MOVES TO HALT CHINESE AI MODEL 'EXPLOITATION'

cluster_stories.title: China to curb US investment in tech companies: Report
cluster_stories.summary: China is set to block top tech firms, including AI startups, from taking US money without official clearance. Regulators have told companies like Moonshot AI and StepFun to reject US investment. TikTok owner ByteDance also faces similar curbs on secondary share sales. These moves aim to safeguard sensitive technologies linked to national security.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS US INVESTMENT IN AI STARTUPS... Moonshot Rejected

cluster_stories.title: China to Curb US Investment in Tech Companies After Meta Deal
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese regulators plan to restrict technology firms including some of the country’s highest-profile AI pioneers from accepting US capital without government approval, part of Beijing’s broader response to Meta Platforms Inc.’s controversial acquisition of startup Manus.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS US INVESTMENT in Tech Giants After Meta Deal

cluster_stories.title: White House accuses China of industrial-scale AI model distillation, commits to intelligence sharing with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google
cluster_stories.summary: Summary: The White House OSTP released a policy memo accusing China of “industrial-scale” distillation of US AI models, committing to share intelligence with US AI companies and explore accountability measures.
